### Get it

| System | Download |
| --- | --- |
| **Windows** 10 and 11, x64 | [`mytube-{version}-windows-amd64-setup.exe`](https://github.com/{repo}/releases/download/{tag}/mytube-{version}-windows-amd64-setup.exe) |
| **Windows** 11 on Arm | [`mytube-{version}-windows-arm64-setup.exe`](https://github.com/{repo}/releases/download/{tag}/mytube-{version}-windows-arm64-setup.exe) |
| **Windows**, without installing | [`mytube-{version}-windows-amd64-portable.zip`](https://github.com/{repo}/releases/download/{tag}/mytube-{version}-windows-amd64-portable.zip), or [`-arm64-portable.zip`](https://github.com/{repo}/releases/download/{tag}/mytube-{version}-windows-arm64-portable.zip) on Arm |

**First launch on Windows.** The installer is not signed yet: if SmartScreen warns, choose More info › Run anyway.

**Playing music.** YouTube Music plays without anything else, apart from a few tracks, such as those made for children, which need yt-dlp: MyTube installs it for you from Settings › Playback. The [README](https://github.com/{repo}/blob/{tag}/README.md#install) lists what Windows needs.

Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS`.
